answer_1.quote: Sup-NatInst, which contains 757 train tasks and 119 evaluation tasks, is the largest and most comprehensive among existing datasets for in-context instruction learning.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates text outputs for diverse NLP tasks such as title generation, question rewriting, grammar error correction, and data-to-text generation, as defined in the Sup-NatInst dataset.

answer_2.quote: All metrics are measured with the Rouge-L score, which quantifies the sentence-level structural similarity; thus, a high Rouge-L score corresponds to the improved performance of a language model.
